title: Design System: The Agent Bazaar Gazette

masthead.purpose: The gazette name, once per page, uppercase.

clause.purpose: Everything the ledger or machine produced: serials, hashes, amounts, stamps.

shadows.name: lifted-hand
shadows.purpose: Only the Summons card casts a shadow: a document handed to the reader.

motion.name: ease-print
motion.purpose: All state transitions: seals, digits, typeset reveals. No bounce.

motion.name: digit-roll
motion.purpose: Settlement digits roll up on value change.

motion.name: bell-swing
motion.purpose: The drawn bell swings when a human is summoned.

components.name: Seal
components.description: Rubber-stamp status: rotated bordered word, stamps in once.
components.css: .ds-seal { display:inline-block; transform: rotate(-7deg); border:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:3px; padding:1px 7px; font-family:'Courier Prime',monospace; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px; } .ds-seal-green { color:#1f6f43; } .ds-seal-red { color:#b3282d; }

components.name: Rule Box
components.description: The gazette's ruled container: square, ink border, inner-page fill.
components.css: .ds-rule-box { border:1.5px solid #1c1a17; background:#faf6ea; padding:16px; color:#1c1a17; font-family:Spectral,Georgia,serif; } .ds-rule-box h3 { font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 4px; } .ds-rule-box p { margin:0; font-size:15px; }

narrative.overview: Live AI-agent commerce rendered as an official government gazette: aged paper, ink, seal red, security-thread gold. Every money action is published as a numbered notification, clause-set in typewriter serials, sealed with a rubber stamp. The category default refused is the dark neon operations dashboard; the paper is picked from the use scene, a record read at a desk under office light.
keyCharacteristics: Everything is ink on paper; color is reserved for authority marks
Status is stamped, never pill-ed; seals pair a word with color
The permanent record is visible before anything live happens

rules.name: The Published-Record Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rendered as live state that is not also in the ledger.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Seal Rule
rules.body: Status is a stamped word, never a colored pill.

rules.name: The Typewriter Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime carries only what the machine or ledger produced.

rules.name: The Lifted-Hand Rule
rules.body: Only the Summons may cast a shadow.

dos: Do set every money figure in Courier Prime with tabular numerals
Do pair every seal word with its color
Do theme browser surfaces (caret, selection, scrollbars)
donts: Don't introduce rounding beyond the 3px paper edge
Don't use em-dashes in rendered strings
Don't add a second shadow style
Don't let seal red exceed roughly a tenth of any screen
